scope: NIFTY single-leg complements; not a whole-system or defined-risk-spread replay
untouched_exam: 2023 is not accessed; existing exam and its candidate list are unchanged
universe: NIFTY weekly long calls and puts present in the sealed Breeze datasets
contracts: nearest permitted expiry, delta approximately 0.55, common normalized lot65 in all years
signals: completed five-minute bars; current-minute option-close observations with archived spread model
fills: synthetic bid/ask around actual historical option candle close; existing minute-observation engine, not actual broker fills
session: existing replay calendar, no expiry-day entries, entry09:45-14:45, hard flat15:10; candidates stop new signals13:30
opening: independent fresh Rs250000 book each year, no initial positions; not one continuous three-year account
main: SHIPPED, OR20, EFF, TPB; yesterday ADX>=30; directional VWAP stretch<0.5 opening30m-range
complements: only yesterday ADX<30 with valid gate; two hypotheses described in PLAN.md; no hindsight day labels
exact: existing risk/cash limits and brakes; max2lots,3whenproven; extra cost=(200+5*lots)*lots applied inside lifecycle
raw: one lot, max6/day, diagnostic brakes disabled, cost=Rs200/lot/trade subtracted after replay; not deployable
sensitivity: Rs300/lot/trade on same raw trades, not a fresh cash-path replay
cash: shared inside each exact combined arm; independent-arm profits are not added together
quality: existing gaps, special-session unresolved risk and known negative-volume bars preserved; no interpolations or source repairs
authority: offline; network disabled during workers; no broker orders, notifications, settings or Production changes
